Heart disease is a leading cause of death in MS & the US. We can fight it. #OurHearts are stronger if we eat healthier, get enough sleep, reduce stress, and quit smoking. ♥️ #AmericanHeartMonth #WearRedDay #ReclaimYourRhythm 

Learn more: https://t.co/p3plbwDiiC https://t.co/BMD5fstV9R

Anyone else dreading losing an hour of sleep tonight as our clocks #SpringForward? Let's end the antiquated practice of a biannual clock change. Congress should pass @SenRubioPress Sunshine Protection Act and embrace a year-long Daylight Saving Time! #LockTheClock

Honored to attend & speak at Judge McNeel’s investiture today. COVID delayed the ceremony, but the wait didn’t diminish this special day. Taylor, as you exercise your power as a federal judge, I pray God grants you wisdom & humility, compassion & courage. Congratulations! https://t.co/CcDLEZe31p

By unfairly singling out Israel, the @UN_HRC undermines its credibility to investigate human rights violations around the world. We're urging @SecBlinken to defend Israel from discriminatory treatment at the Human Rights Council and throughout the UN system.

Mental health is health. Tomorrow begins #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth. Check in on yourself and the people you care about. You can find the warning signs of a mental health condition here: https://t.co/Iwhvz5xzSA 
@NAMIMississippi @NAMIAdvocacy https://t.co/8ep0tpF6BA

Expecting/new mothers deserve every ounce of support they can get & should know what resources are available to them. @MarcoRubio's bill would create a one-stop-shop of resources for anything from prenatal healthcare to infant nutrition, housing, or adoption options.

Pleased to celebrate US District Judge Kristi Johnson’s investiture. She’s the first woman federal judge for the Southern District of MS. Judge Johnson, as you exercise your power, I pray that God will grant you wisdom, humility, compassion, & courage. Congratulations! https://t.co/qEhMTnC1QM

Great news: The @USDA approved the purchase of up to $42 million of catfish products to distribute to various nutrition assistance programs, including charitable institutions. This will help to strengthen rural America and help our catfish farmers weather tough times.

Mississippians understand the financial stresses on their local hospitals & how devastating it would be if they were forced to close. The Rural Hospital Support Act would ensure that certain Medicare programs on which hospitals rely are authorized permanently. Details:

MS knows all too well the suffering that comes with a diabetes diagnosis, and hardships are multiplied for rural patients. Checked in with Dr. Griffin P. Rodgers at today's #approps hearing to learn what @NIDDKgov is doing to rectify these disparities for rural Mississippians.

I'm honored to receive the @HealthInFocus Champion of Healthcare Innovation award. I will continue to support policies that will work to ensure access to quality care and coverage for patients, and support our healthcare workforce. Thank you for this recognition! https://t.co/ZetwwBwZya

It’s just logical that an aging population will result in a greater demand for hospice & palliative care. PCHETA will help ensure that a well-trained workforce is ready to serve patients & can also help control some costs to our health care system.

The demand for transplant organs grows every year. Unfortunately, the system to ensure fairness and efficiency in distributing those organs isn’t working well, often to the detriment of patients in the South. This newly enacted law provides tools to address shortcomings.

Today @LynnFitchAG unveiled an amazing resource for Mama’s-- access to healthcare services, child care, food, shelter, adoption services, and more! Check out https://t.co/NTTD1qKqwW to see how Mississippi can help you. ❤️

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, a time for us to educate and spread knowledge on breast cancer, it's symptoms, and common risk factors! We will never stop working toward a future free of breast cancer. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth 🌸 https://t.co/jjNOcSBEJI https://t.co/LB8Lc0HOAF

This week, leading up to #VeteransDay, I had the joy of sitting down with Gary Hagen, a Vietnam Dustoff Crew Chief. The Dustoff Crew transported the wounded safely to aid stations & hospitals, & no doubt saved many, many lives. His story is awe-inspiring. Thanks for coming by! https://t.co/SGoHpUSxlv

MS is facing some very severe potential hospital closures, and it's critical that we have access to rural healthcare. I got to hear Dr. Gooden’s thoughts on ensuring @usdaRD programs support rural healthcare & our hospitals, should he be confirmed. @SenateAgGOP More:

Another great year speaking at CTeL’s fall summit! Even before the pandemic, Mississippi has felt the importance of telehealth, especially to our rural areas. I look forward to continuing to work on ways to move telehealth into a more permanent place in our healthcare systems! https://t.co/EsgnbLFVWi

For too long, too many Mississippians have struggled with obesity. We've got to keep working to see health improvements across our state. I’ve cosponsored the 'Treat and Reduce Obesity Act’ to improve Medicare access to obesity care services and treatments.

63% of older adults who are overweight have an interest in taking prescription meds for weight management & 76% think Medicare should cover prescriptions for weight management. The 'Treat and Reduce Obesity Act' would do just that. Check out this poll: https://t.co/ZkgqS2pZj1

Liberal states like CA have gamed the system to provide Medicaid to illegal immigrants, which is against the law & forces MS taxpayers to foot some of the bill. Our legislation would stop the abuse of the program & force liberal states to carry the burden of their choices. More:

It's that time of year again, where we needlessly lose an hour of sleep and disrupt schedules to set our clocks for the start of #DaylightSavingTime. Still hoping our bill to #LockTheClock finds its way to the President's desk so we can end this irrational practice. https://t.co/hPfS0YoTU4

Talked with @SecBecerra about whether some Mississippi hospitals at risk of closure could be enrolled in a demonstration program that would improve their reimbursement rates, among other rural health challenges facing our state. Read more: https://t.co/EW6Fa0uPVe https://t.co/DT9RFF64jD

People who live & work in rural areas need basic emergency health services, but too many rural hospitals are in danger of closing or have already closed. My bill would amend an existing program to improve chances that rural residents can keep or regain access to care. Details:

We know telehealth works, as demonstrated by how quickly Medicare beneficiaries came to rely on telemedicine during the pandemic. This bill would get us past short-term extensions & give seniors certainty that their access to telehealth services is protected. Read more about it:
